title: Finite and Dynamic Stability Horizons for Nearest-Neighbor Future Structures
summary: Nearest-neighbor graphs are discrete objects whose membership may change under small perturbations of the underlying coordinates. We establish an explicit stability guarantee for finite labeled configurations in an arbitrary metric space. If the gap between the kth and (k+1)st distances is positive, simultaneous per-label perturbations smaller than one quarter of that gap preserve the directed k-nearest-neighbor membership.
